method: Three synthetic development scenarios crossed with two context policies, one generation each. Not independent holdout samples or a release qualification.
model_contract: classification-v1 with deterministic amount tool and strict unmodified JSON parsing

messages.content: You classify a synthetic order-support review. Never execute payment. Reply with exactly one JSON object and no markdown. Keys: disposition (refund, zero, or abstain), reason (nonempty string), evidence_ids (nonempty array of bracketed context IDs without brackets). Choose refund only if verified delay >=30 minutes and no prior compensation exception. Choose zero for prior compensation or delay <30. Choose abstain if amount or delay evidence missing. Do not calculate any money; a deterministic tool calculates cents.

[policy.evidence] If order amount or delay evidence is unavailable, abstain and request manual review.
